name: Feature

hero.title: You have built this CRUD screen before. Declare it this time.
hero.lede: Give `defineFeature` a name, a Zod schema and a REST path. You get the list, detail and search queries, create, update and delete mutations that refresh the list, a validated form that saves itself, a table with columns from the schema, and a store, all wired to Pyreon's query, form, table and store packages.

why.title: The resource boilerplate, generated from the schema you already wrote.

items.title: The list never goes stale
items.text: Create, update and delete invalidate the `['posts']` query on success. Add a post and every `useList()` on screen refetches: `GET`, `POST`, `GET`.

items.title: A form that knows where to send itself
items.text: `Posts.useForm()` starts from the schema's defaults, validates with it, and `POST`s on submit. `useForm({ mode: 'edit', id })` loads the record first and `PUT`s instead.

items.title: Generated, not hidden
items.text: Each hook is the real `@pyreon/query`, `@pyreon/form`, `@pyreon/table` or `@pyreon/store` object. Take one generated piece and hand-write the next; `<Posts.Field>` renders one field, so your layout stays yours.

difference.title: The same screen, before and after.

before.label: React + TanStack Query + react-hook-form + Zod
before.caption: Query keys, fetchers, invalidation and a resolver, per resource. Then update and delete, the same again.

after.label: with @pyreon/feature
after.caption: One declaration. The form validates, posts and refreshes the list on its own.

demo.title: What one declaration gives you.
demo.text: Click a generated member to see what it does. The table on the right uses `useList`, `useCreate` and `useDelete`: add a row and the list refetches.

demo.spec: Same as the reference, with one correction to the copy: `useSearch` is "a search query that refetches when the term signal changes (sent as `?q=`), disabled while the term is empty". It is not debounced; pair it with a debounced signal (e.g. `debounce` from `@pyreon/rx`) if you need that.

items.name: `useList({ page, pageSize, params })`
items.text: A `@pyreon/query` list query; `page` can be a signal.

items.name: `useSearch(term)`
items.text: Pass a signal; it refetches with `?q=` when the term changes and waits while it is empty.

items.name: `useCreate` / `useUpdate` / `useDelete`
items.text: Mutations that invalidate the feature's queries on success.

items.name: `useForm({ mode, id })`
items.text: A `@pyreon/form` state with schema validation; create posts, edit loads the record and puts.

items.name: `useTable(data, { columns })`
items.text: A TanStack Table v9 instance from `@pyreon/table`, columns from the schema.

items.name: `useStore()`
items.text: A `@pyreon/store` with cached items, selection and loading.

items.name: `<Posts.Field>` / `<Posts.Table>`
items.text: Label, typed control and error for one field; a sortable table with per-column cell overrides.

items.name: `reference(Users)`
items.text: Mark a foreign key to another feature.

items.name: `fields`, `extractFields`, `defaultInitialValues`
items.text: The schema introspection, for building your own UI.

recipes.title: An admin list with search and delete
recipes.text: The generated table, a search box bound to `useSearch`, and a delete button that refreshes the list when it succeeds.

recipes.title: An edit page
recipes.text: Edit mode loads the record, refuses to submit until it has arrived (so blank defaults never overwrite it), and sends `PUT /api/posts/:id` on save.

api.title: A small surface that generates a large one.

limits.title: Conventional REST under one path
limits.text: The routes are derived from `api`: `GET /`, `GET /:id`, `POST /`, `PUT /:id`, `DELETE /:id`. Other shapes need a custom `fetcher`, or the underlying `@pyreon/query` hooks directly.

limits.title: Fields and columns come from Zod
limits.text: Valibot, ArkType and `@pyreon/validate` schemas validate, but auto form fields, columns and create defaults are read from Zod only. With another schema, pass `initialValues` and columns; a one-time dev warning says so.

limits.title: Needs a `QueryClientProvider`
limits.text: The generated queries and mutations are `@pyreon/query` hooks, so mount a `QueryClient` above them.

limits.title: On native, the declaration crosses
limits.text: With a literal field map, iOS and Android get a Codable struct and `initialValues`. An inline `z.object` of scalars, with on-device `safeParse`, follows in the next release. The generated hooks stay web. Native targets are experimental.

faq.a: No files are written. `defineFeature` runs at import time and returns an object whose members are the real query, form, table and store hooks, typed from your schema.

Yes. Use `Posts.useForm()` with your own markup, replace one `<Posts.Field>` with a hand-written input, or skip the generated table and call `@pyreon/table` with the data from `Posts.useList()`. Nothing is all-or-nothing.

faq.q: What about auth headers or a different backend?
faq.a: Pass `fetcher`, any function with the `fetch` signature, to add headers, a base URL or a different transport.

faq.q: Does it work with Valibot or ArkType?
faq.a: For validation, yes, through the Standard Schema bridge in `@pyreon/validation`. For auto fields and columns, use Zod or pass them yourself.
